entities._comment: The witch's cottage -- the ONE warm window inside a cool green-dark frame (spec sec.1's landmark read 6, 'the contrast IS the storytelling'). 5x5 sprite, block ~5x3 at its base. Carries the map's single warm PointLight2D, always-on (a lived-in cottage keeps its hearth lit day and night, unlike the phase-gated street/pantry lanterns) -- stays within the ≤8/map light budget (the only light this map ships).
entities.observe: A mossy, sagging roof, a crooked chimney, and one window that's always lit no matter the hour.
entities.toast: The door's shut. Whatever's inside isn't asking for company right now.

entities.observe: A stone taller than it should be able to stand on its own, glowing faint purple at the seams.
Another of the ring-stones, humming faintly if you hold still.

entities._comment: R3 (issue #11) SKILL gauntlet, prop 1 of 3: 'cook the offering' (basic_cooking). Field-skill first-use idiom (stew_pot/cellar_door precedent) -- requires_skill + on_skill_use, unordered relative to the other two props (no sequencing gate exists in this seam; the QA canonical performs them in narrative order). Reuses the registered `cauldron` sprite (stew_pot's own sprite), west of the cottage door.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The pot waits for something cooked plain and honest.
entities.locked_toast: Something's meant to go in this, cooked properly. You don't know your way around a stew pot. Yet.

on_skill_use.toast: [Basic Cooking] — You cook the offering plain and honest, the way you'd feed anyone who'd walked far to eat.

entities.observe: An iron pot set by the cottage door, empty and waiting. Someone means for it to be used.

entities._comment: SKILL gauntlet, prop 2 of 3: 'light the threshold candles' ([Light]). Reuses the registered `unlit_lantern` sprite (the [Light] skill's own established prop), east of the cottage door -- the other flank of the threshold from hollow_offering_pot. The `visual_states` lit swap is REQUIRED, not decoration: the on_skill_use toast narrates the candles catching, and a toast promising a visible change with no sprite/tint change is the exact 'logically correct but never rendered' gotcha class -- same warm tint + flickering light as the inn's own unlit_lantern (the precedent), keyed on this prop's own accomplishment. Light budget: witch_hollow carries 1 base light (witch_cottage_prop) before this, well under the 8/map cap.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Cold candle-stubs either side of the door. No match will do it.
entities.locked_toast: A row of cold candle-stubs, set either side of the door. Whatever lights them, it isn't a match.

on_skill_use.toast: [Light] — The candles catch, one after another, without a flame ever touching them.

entities.observe: Cold wax and old wicks, set along the threshold like they're waiting for something specific.

entities._comment: R3 (issue #11) SKILL gauntlet, prop 3 of 3: 'observe the true knot' ([Observe]). Placed in the empty center of the standing-stone triangle (hollow_glow_1/2/3's own cells) -- the ritual clearing the spec calls out. THIS is the SKILL path's convergence bank: completing the gauntlet yourself IS the resolution, no separate report needed (unlike the cisterns_scout/wrong_order precedent, whose single skill action needed a consult-NPC report to close the loop) -- reuses the registered `hollow_mushroom_cluster` sprite (previously decor-only) as a distinct interactive tangle, visually apart from the standing stones themselves.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The knot is too deliberate for briar. It wants a closer look than eyes give for free.
entities.locked_toast: Roots and briar, knotted tighter than any plant ties itself. Whatever it's holding, an untrained eye won't find it.

on_skill_use.toast: [Observe] — The knot isn't wood at all, once you look right at it: a price, tied off and waiting to be paid. You pay it yourself, plainly, and the tension goes out of the air like a held breath let go.

entities.observe: A snarl of root and briar at the center of the standing stones, tied in a knot that doesn't look like it grew that way.

entities._comment: #63 canon pass: entity swapped from a generic witch to Eloise (wiki-verified, character-profiles.md). This ALSO resolves the #17 audit's coin-vs-favors finding -- the generic witch trading for coin (shop node) while also collecting a debt-in-favors (mediate/blight_lifted) read as two contradictory roles on one invented character. Eloise is canonically a travelling trader of sorts as well as a [Tea Witch], so coin-for-goods and favor-for-service are both native to HER, not a role clash; the contradiction dies with the generic witch it was about.
talk_pool: Sit. The tea is nearly right, and nothing sensible was ever decided standing up.
Kindness asks questions, dear. That is my craft, so forgive me for asking several.
The village worries loudly. I prefer to worry with a pot on.
entities.observe: A small grey witch in a hat pressed with tea leaves and old flowers. She holds a cup like the answer to a question you haven't asked yet.

lines: The fields breathe easier. So do I. Tea?
You did the hollow a kindness. It remembers, and so do I.

dialogue.speaker: Eloise
dialogue.text: Tea's still hot. The offer doesn't get warmer with asking twice.

entities._comment_visual_states: TWO entries, phase-split on purpose: dusk swaps the sprite only (dusk grade [0.4,0.58,0.5] leaves the young form readable bare), while night ALSO lifts her with a self-tint -- witch_hollow's night grade [0.2,0.34,0.3] crushes sprite detail to near-silhouette, and the two-form swap IS the tell (it must survive the grade; the dark-arena combat brightness-floor precedent, applied entity-side since field NPCs get no combat _legibility_boost). Uniform 2.0 lands her at ~[0.4,0.68,0.6] final under the night grade -- clearly readable, still night-cast, and diegetically right (the young form reading faintly luminous after dark). Entries are order-sensitive: later satisfied entries override, and each phase matches exactly one here.

entities._comment: LOCKED interface: arena witch_hollow, on_victory drove_off_collectors (lane beta/R2). The 'shallow' variant, near the entrance path. entities.observe: Briars, moving without wind. They haven't noticed you yet.

entities._comment: LOCKED interface: same arena as the shallow briar_collectors (both fights share the witch_hollow arena template, lane beta/R2). The trees thin out this way. Open fields past the last few trunks.

entities._comment: R6 (#95) trap placement: a briar-snare east of briar_collectors' nest (9,6). Cell (10,7) verified off every riverfarm_* canonical's real walked-cell set inside witch_hollow: every reposition rides `teleport` (never treads intermediate cells) with only 1-step facing bumps at the teleport targets themselves -- {(3,9),(10,11),(6,6),(6,5),(2,8),(4,8),(4,9),(4,10),(8,11),(9,7),(4,12)} is the full real-move set across riverfarm_walkthrough/talk/skill/fight. (10,7) is not in that set, not blocked (witch_hollow's blocked list only closes the y5-6 x1-5 band + the 3 standing-stone cells), and not any entity's cell. requires_skill=observe LIVE (disarm_trap PARKED -- docs/design/class-foundation-staging/trap-disarm-swap.json). Avoidable: single-cell prop, open floor on every side. Disarm banks shared trap_disarmed + 1g.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Brambles knotted into a tight loop, low against the undergrowth. Nothing grows that way on its own.
entities.locked_toast: The brambles here twist into a tight loop, low to the ground. It doesn't look natural. You can't tell how to clear it without setting it off.

on_skill_use.toast: You work the knot loose one bramble at a time, careful of the thorns. Snagged in the weave: a coin, tarnished green from the damp.
